text:
zoe: Noticing a ~18% p99 bump on host parse for small chunked requests after the KV warmup refactor. Traces attached.

parth: repro steps?

zoe: rtx-dedicated, chunked transfer, many tiny messages. curl example: curl -H 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' -d '{\"input\":\"ok\"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate

anya: flame summary: parse::validate_prefix (32%), tokenizer::scan_ascii_fast (20%), kv::warm_prefix_v2 (16%), grpc::writev (14%), batching::heuristic_eval (10%), misc 8%.

parth: looks like warm_prefix_v2 runs per-request before ingress coalesce; kernel picker then falls back to tolerant kernel causing copies.

zoe: short mitigation: gate warm_prefix for tiny requests (chunk_count < 3 && total_bytes < 2048) and emit metric parse.warm_skipped. I opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4799

infra-bot: canary started on pool=rtx-dedicated-canary hosts=4 image=runtime:pr-4799 ramp=30m link=https://canary.redwood.dev/4799

anya: while canary runs I'll prototype incremental per-connection prefix cache (memoize first 4kb) and a kernel-picker hint when fragmentation is detected.

parth: also consider ingress micro-coalesce (1-2ms delay) to reduce writev/syscall churn for tiny streaming frames.

zoe: added dashboard widgets: parse.p95/p99, parse.warm_skipped rate, kernel.choice_reason. Synthetic chat load running.

anya: early canary (10m): p95 -8%, p99 -13%, host CPU -9%. parse.warm_skipped ~60% on tiny requests.

parth: good. Next: 3h canary, land incremental cache, update batching heuristic to prefer coalesce before warmup, and add a perf-harness test for fragmented chunked frames.

zoe: filing INF-1320 to track follow-ups and will post 3h flame snapshots.

infra-bot: ticket INF-1320 created.

parth: nice catch. :thumbsup:
